title: FinGREAT: Evaluating LLMs on Financial Graph-guided Retrieval And Typing
abstract: arXiv:2610.19240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial disclosures express the underlying relationships of double-entry accounting through unstructured text. While financial LLM benchmarks predominantly emphasize question answering and classification, schema-guided evidence discovery remains relatively under-explored. We investigate whether open-weight LLMs can extract and classify evidence corresponding to predefined double-entry accounting relationships underlying the text. Using a financial accounting graph comprising 11 nodes (accounts) and 11 edges (transaction types), we evaluate mid-sized models from 5 open-weight families across 1,300 SEC 10-K Item 7 filings spanning 26 years, comparing their extraction performance against three proprietary models. Results reveal substantial differences in extraction volume, edge distributions, and cross-model agreement. translated_title: FinGREAT：在金融图引导的检索与类型识别任务上评估大语言模型
translated_abstract: 金融披露通过非结构化文本表达了复式记账法的底层关系。尽管金融领域的大语言模型基准测试主要侧重于问答和分类，但基于模式（schema）引导的证据发现仍然相对缺乏研究。我们探究了开源权重的大语言模型能否提取并分类与文本背后预定义的复式记账关系相对应的证据。我们使用一个由11个节点（账户）和11条边（交易类型）构成的金融会计图，评估了来自5个开源权重模型家族的中等规模模型，覆盖跨越26年的1,300份SEC 10-K年报第7项（管理层讨论与分析），并将其提取性能与三个专有模型进行对比。结果显示，各模型在提取数量、边分布以及跨模型一致性方面存在显著差异。基于该研究，我们进一步引入了一个包含483个段落的人工标注关系分类基准。
tldr: 该论文提出FinGREAT基准，基于包含11个账户节点和11种交易类型边的金融会计图，在跨越26年的1,300份SEC 10-K文件上系统评估了开源大语言模型提取和分类复式记账关系证据的能力，并发布了含483个段落的人工标注关系分类基准。
